# Majestic Blazer

> Handcrafted luxury menswear, hand-canvassed blazers, and black-tie tuxedos in Coimbatore, India. Style That Speaks.

Majestic Blazer is a premier menswear boutique located on Sathy Road, Kurumbampalayam, Coimbatore - 641107. We offer curated formal blazers, velvet wedding & partywear silhouettes, double-breasted classics, and Super 140s wool tuxedos with complimentary master alterations.

## Public Storefront Pages

- [Home](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/): Flagship showcase, featured blazers, and Coimbatore atelier overview.
- [Shop Blazers](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/shop): Full public catalog with filters for category, chest size, shade, and price.
- [Wedding & Partywear](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/shop?category=wedding-partywear): Velvet blazers and embroidered bandhgalas.
- [Tuxedos & Black Tie](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/shop?category=tuxedos-black-tie): Satin shawl-collar evening wear and tuxedos.
- [Formal & Corporate](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/shop?category=formal-blazers): Worsted wool and double-breasted boardroom blazers.
- [Casual & Smart](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/shop?category=casual-smart): Unstructured linen and tailored weekend blazers.
- [Boutique & Contact](https://majestic-blazer-id.vercel.app/contact): Private fitting appointments, store hours, and location details.
